name: VidKing Integration
description: Resolves .vking files (TMDb/IMDb ID pointers) into Jellyfin media items. Optional Playwright-based extraction of real MP4 URLs from 1Embed.cc for native playback.
overview: Resolves .vking files into playable media items. Tier 1: optional real MP4 extraction via headless Chromium (native playback for server + apps). Tier 2: stream proxy endpoint for web clients. Tier 3: iframe fallback.

versions.changelog: Initial release. Resolves .vking files. Optional MP4 stream extraction from 1Embed.cc via headless Chromium + Playwright. Stream proxy endpoint for web clients. Iframe fallback.
